subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A city is often planned by what people can see.”?
options: A map can help people understand the world, but it can also quietly teach them where they think the center is.
The town showed that sometimes less allows people to see more.
The carbon label showed that it also has public effects.
The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A map can help people understand the world, but it can also quietly teach them where they think…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The town showed that sometimes less allows people to see more.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The carbon label showed that it also has public effects.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A city is often planned by what people can see. The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A city is often planned by what people can see. The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.」，答案為「The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The noise map showed that what people hear also needs planning.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
